place: Plai Laem, Choeng Mon, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani, Thailand
title: Four-Bedroom Contemporary Pool Villa with Panoramic Sea Views, Gym and Games Room
blurb: A four-bedroom contemporary Thai villa on two levels in Plai Laem, with an infinity pool and jacuzzi, floor-to-ceiling glass and a wide, unbroken view across the bay — plus a gym, spa room, games room and a 648 m² garden.
detail:
Set on the hillside above Plai Laem, this two-level villa was built in 2016 around one idea: the view. Walls of floor-to-ceiling glass slide away so that the dining room, the lounge and the terrace open onto a long infinity pool, with jungle-covered hills and the bay beyond. Inside, everything stays white and calm — pale floors, clean lines and a few Thai artworks and red-lacquer accents that give the rooms their character.

The main level is one generous open-plan space: a kitchen with an island and breakfast bar, a table that seats ten or more, and a lounge that runs straight onto the pool deck. A Thai sala with ocean views and a sound system on the terrace make it an easy place to entertain from lunch until after sunset.

All four bedrooms are en-suite, each with its own view, and most open to a private terrace; the main suite has a deep freestanding bathtub and dressing area, and the bedrooms carry their own TV and sound systems. Upstairs, a fully equipped gym looks out over the hills, and a games room with a pool table sits beside a spa room with twin and double treatment beds. A jacuzzi beside the pool completes the wellness programme.

The house offers around 1,000 m² of living space and a 648 m² landscaped garden. It comes with a chanote title deed, security cameras, a backup generator, Wi-Fi throughout and parking for two cars, and is offered furnished and ready to move into.
